mechanism: formal capacity separates from usable capability
domains: public systems, insurance, infrastructure, AI, logistics, geopolitics
observed_stage: coverage, eligibility, rule, funding, connection, approval or payout
open_conversion: same-unit use, receipt, adequacy, safety, continuity and recovery
evidence_boundary: aggregate or institutional capacity does not prove person household or community benefit
next_acquisition: name one person household account facility or partner and trace eligibility through use and later continuity
promotion_rule: promote only when the same unit has a dated usable outcome and an explicit counterexample

domains: infrastructure, climate mobility, energy, water, culture, transport, heritage
observed_stage: named place, exposure, public process, route or planning conflict
open_conversion: decision influence, burden distribution, condition compliance and durable acceptance
evidence_boundary: hearing consultation or policy framework proves visibility or intent not power or legitimacy
next_acquisition: trace a named project through decision record conditions participation implementation and post-operation response
promotion_rule: promote only when participation changes a recorded term or when non-consent produces a documented alternative

domains: platforms, benefits, public AI, health, identity, consumer remedy
observed_stage: notice, appeal, review, deletion, reissue, reversal or formal remedy
open_conversion: response time, correction persistence, recurrence, claimant cost and continued participation
evidence_boundary: order, grievance rate or reversal does not prove recovered welfare or durable access
next_acquisition: obtain case-level request action receipt residual state and later use or exit
promotion_rule: promote only when correction is observed at the claimant or account level and recurrence is tested

mechanism: resilience is qualified maintained and distributed
domains: supply chains, energy, insurance, robotics, autonomy, defense, agriculture
observed_stage: capacity, backup, substitute, pilot, procurement or risk-pool architecture
open_conversion: qualification, operation, maintenance, failure, user response and distributional incidence
evidence_boundary: ownership, capacity, enrollment or procurement does not prove quality timing cost safety or durability
next_acquisition: follow one asset or substitute through qualification operation maintenance failure and user or partner response
promotion_rule: promote only when the substitute works at required quality scale timing and cost with burden allocation recorded

mechanism: hidden effort is social and geographical infrastructure
domains: care, households, education, health, administration, digital access, participation
observed_stage: time, navigation, verification, training, maintenance or caregiving requirement
open_conversion: who supplies effort, what it displaces, whether supported or paid and whether it is recoverable
evidence_boundary: formal availability does not reveal time cash language mobility disability or trust constraints
next_acquisition: link a defined burden to a chosen alternative and later work care health security or participation outcome
promotion_rule: promote only when effort is measured for a named unit and the displaced or protected domain is observed

mechanism: attribution turns incidence into legitimacy or leverage
domains: technology, infrastructure, culture, public systems, alliances, geopolitics
observed_stage: burden, benefit, event, exposure, dependence or strategic claim
open_conversion: responsible actor, causal bridge, meaning, repeat behavior, cooperation, refusal or leverage
evidence_boundary: proximity, rhetoric or public concern does not establish causation or population effect
next_acquisition: match a named incident or outcome to operator payer decision and affected actor using comparison where possible
promotion_rule: promote only when attribution is explicit, alternatives are preserved and later behavior or institutional response is observed

domains: digital identity, G2P payments, public services, social protection

open_conversion: same person proofing or payment fees control real value service receipt correction and repeated security
evidence_boundary: policy scale and interoperability do not prove same-recipient access or recovery
next_acquisition: join identity payment account recipient and service records across two or more cycles
promotion_rule: promote only when a named recipient crosses proofing payment use and correction stages

domains: climate relocation, disability-inclusive warnings, anticipatory action
observed_stage: displacement scale relocation finance warning receipt multichannel operation child-risk mapping and inclusion principles
open_conversion: choice to stay or move impairment-specific action transport shelter medication land host capacity and continuity
evidence_boundary: risk maps consultations and warning coverage do not prove protective action or community continuity
next_acquisition: trace a named household or community from hazard or relocation decision through action services and recovery voice
promotion_rule: promote only when action and post-event continuity are observed for the affected unit

evidence_boundary: system prices policy support and market functionality do not prove safe affordable household use
next_acquisition: pair market or utility events with household purchase indoor condition health and repeated-use records
